definition: a general rise in prices across an economy over time
example: High inflation has made everyday goods more expensive for families.

definition: a period when a country's economy performs badly and businesses suffer
example: Many companies had to lay off staff during the recession.

definition: money given by the government to support an industry or activity
example: The government offers subsidies to farmers to keep food prices low.

definition: the income a government or company receives
example: The company's revenue grew by 20% last year.

definition: the money a person has left to spend or save after paying taxes
example: Rising prices have reduced the disposable income of many households.

definition: a raw material or basic product that can be bought and sold, such as oil or coffee
example: The price of commodities like oil affects the entire global economy.

definition: to rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example: Currency exchange rates fluctuate constantly depending on market conditions.

definition: the percentage of people who are able to work but do not have a job
example: The unemployment rate rose sharply during the economic downturn.

definition: the tendency of people to buy and consume goods in ever greater amounts
example: Critics argue that consumerism encourages people to buy things they don't need.

definition: complete control of an entire industry by one company
example: The company was accused of holding a monopoly over the local market.

definition: to pay another company to provide a service rather than doing it yourself
example: Many businesses outsource their customer service to reduce costs.

definition: a tax charged on goods imported from or exported to another country
example: The government raised tariffs on imported steel to protect local producers.

definition: to encourage economic activity or growth
example: The government cut interest rates to stimulate economic growth.

definition: capable of working successfully; practical and feasible
example: Solar power is becoming a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
